policy.decision_unit: exact Charon source identity plus its compiler, configuration, serialized/API, consumer, and packaged-runtime evidence

gates.title: Resolve the exact producer identity
required: Resolve the proposed Aeneas revision/release first, then read its charon-pin and locked Charon input.
Record the exact Charon commit, package version, and any Charon release/tag label separately.
Verify that the Charon binaries actually packaged with Aeneas are built from the intended locked input.
Record hashes of the concrete Aeneas/Charon artifacts Anneal will consume.
reject_if: charon-pin and the locked Charon input disagree
the proposed Charon identity is inferred only from a date tag or 0.1.x package version
the packaged Charon provenance cannot be tied to the reviewed source

gates.title: Revalidate the rustc-private toolchain contract
required: Read the proposed Charon rust-toolchain and record the channel, components, and targets.
Verify the compiler actually supplied by Anneal matches the toolchain required by Charon's rustc-private driver.
Exercise the production provisioning path, including CHARON_TOOLCHAIN_IS_IN_PATH or rustup behavior as applicable.
Record rustc -vV identity from the packaged runtime.
reject_if: the packaged/runtime rustc differs from the reviewed Charon toolchain without an explicit compatibility justification
required rustc-private components or dynamic libraries are absent
a host succeeds only by accidentally finding an ambient toolchain

gates.title: Freeze and compare the invocation and Aeneas preset contract
required: Diff CliOpts, Preset::Aeneas, default MIR level, start/opacity rules, error-policy options, and serialization defaults.
Record the exact Charon command/configuration Anneal uses and whether Cargo or direct-rustc mode owns compilation context.
Check internal wrapper-to-driver option transport and target-selection behavior for changes relevant to orchestration.
Preserve a machine-readable snapshot of the production-effective option set.
reject_if: the production path silently stops applying the Aeneas preset
a preset/default change alters proof-relevant transformations without review
the new invocation reaches a different compilation subject than the reviewed one

gates.title: Revalidate serialized LLBC and charon_lib as separate interfaces
required: Diff CrateData, AST/schema definitions, generated OCaml readers, serialization formats, and Charon version machinery.
Confirm the Aeneas reader accepts the intended producer and rejects mismatched supported versions as expected.
If Anneal uses charon_lib in process, separately compile/review that exact Rust API boundary rather than treating LLBC compatibility as sufficient.
Preserve representative JSON or Postcard specimens from fixed Rust inputs for structural comparison.
reject_if: the producer/consumer pair is selected only because package version strings match
a schema/API change is unreviewed
a serialized specimen no longer decodes under the intended consumer

gates.title: Diff the semantic transformation pipeline
required: Diff pass ordering, should_run predicates, Aeneas-preset-controlled passes, MIR level, resugaring, normalization, and output simplification.

Review changes to passes that reconstruct assertions/fallible operations, indexing, associated types, trait structure, drops, constants, intrinsics, and control flow when relevant to Anneal's supported corpus.
Regenerate fixed-input LLBC specimens and review semantic as well as textual changes.
reject_if: a proof-relevant transformation changes without a corresponding semantic review
a new pass depends on rustc MIR shape that changed with the selected nightly and no discriminating test covers it

gates.title: Rebuild the support and fail-closed boundary
required: Diff explicit unsupported/error/panic paths, known unsoundness trackers, and the Aeneas-preset support surface.
Recheck ErrorCtx continuation, CrateData.has_errors, serialization-before-final-error-policy behavior, and process exit classes.
Verify Anneal treats any promise-relevant Charon error/partial result as failure even if the default Charon process can serialize partial output.
Run positive, warning/partial, hard-error, panic/ICE, and timeout discriminators where the execution surface permits.
reject_if: partial LLBC can enter Aeneas/Anneal as complete proof input
a formerly rejected construct becomes accepted without semantic review
a known unsound transformation remains enabled for Anneal without an explicit decision

gates.title: Revalidate what program is translated and how it maps back to source
required: Diff start-root, include/opaque/exclude, dependency/body-availability, cfg/target, and foreign-item coverage behavior.
Diff item identity, names, file/span/location structures, comment/source-content handling, and any metadata used by diagnostics or proof provenance.
Verify fixed fixtures still map the same semantic items and user-source ranges when Anneal relies on stable correspondence.
reject_if: the translated semantic closure narrows or widens without review
item/span identity changes invalidate diagnostics or source-correspondence assumptions without migration evidence

gates.title: Revalidate multi-target and multi-primary Cargo behavior
required: If production uses multiple targets, exercise the exact --targets fan-out/merge path and inspect target-dispatch results.
If one Cargo invocation can contain multiple primary target units, ensure outputs cannot collide or overwrite each other under Anneal's chosen destination policy.
Review target classification, CARGO_PRIMARY_PACKAGE handling, crate-name-derived output naming, and merge semantics.
reject_if: concurrent/serial primary compiler units can write the same intended artifact without an explicit aggregation/staging policy
cross-target semantic differences are silently deduplicated or merged contrary to the reviewed behavior

gates.title: Revalidate the exact Aeneas consumer boundary
required: Use the Aeneas revision that selects the proposed Charon, not a same-date Charon tag or nearby Aeneas release.
Check the Aeneas LLBC reader/generated Charon-ML definitions against the proposed producer.
Run fixed LLBC specimens and a small Rust-to-LLBC-to-Aeneas translation corpus through the exact producer/consumer pair.
If Anneal separately carries a different charon_lib revision, prove it is unused or validate any active cross-revision edge explicitly.
reject_if: Aeneas and Charon source identities are paired by naming/date convention instead of the locked dependency graph
an active cross-revision LLBC or in-memory API edge lacks direct compatibility evidence

gates.title: Separate same-revision determinism from cross-revision drift
required: Repeat production-mode Charon extraction from identical clean inputs and compare normalized and raw artifacts where byte identity matters.
Compare old-versus-new LLBC for fixed fixtures separately from same-revision repetition.
Preserve commands, environment, compiler/Charon identities, output hashes, and any order-sensitive diffs.
Treat deterministic but intentionally changed output as a migration question rather than a determinism failure.
reject_if: cache/reuse correctness assumes deterministic bytes that were not established in the production mode
cross-revision output changes are dismissed solely because each revision is internally deterministic

gates.title: Validate the packaged Charon runtime on every supported Anneal host
required: Test the exact Aeneas archive/Anneal toolchain artifact rather than only a development checkout.
On each supported host, verify charon, charon-driver, the pinned Rust sysroot, required dynamic libraries, Cargo, and path/runtime environment cooperate after installation/relocation.
Run a real translation rather than only --help or version output.
Record artifact hashes and host triple with the result.
reject_if: a supported host lacks a working compiler/runtime dependency
the artifact succeeds only before relocation or only in the upstream build environment
the test exercises a different Charon binary than the one Anneal will invoke

gates.title: Finish with a discriminating end-to-end corpus
required: Exercise ordinary ADTs/control flow, shared and mutable borrows, raw-pointer/unsafe cases in scope, loops/recursion, traits, foreign/dependency references, and at least one expected failure.
Preserve the Rust inputs, exact rustc/Charon/Aeneas identities, effective Charon options, LLBC, downstream generated artifacts, diagnostics, and hashes.
Review changed LLBC semantically and confirm Anneal's proof/source-correspondence invariants remain justified.
reject_if: component checks pass but the exact packaged Rust-to-Charon-to-Aeneas composition fails
the corpus no longer distinguishes a promise-relevant failure mode exposed by source review
